stations.title: Kwame
stations.say: My reminders say a day early.

stations.title: Your code
stations.gap: The date moves with the laptop

captions: At Wrenhaven Scores, Kwame sends the reminders from Vancouver and they say a day early.
The code reads the due date in one zone and shows it in the laptop's.
You catch it in a test, keep the date a calendar date, and test the case next door.
Now the reminder shows the invoice's own date, wherever the laptop is.
Same invoice, same choir. The date is the one on the invoice.
